RebelABTesting.TagDescription: Shows the variant of an experiment to half of the visitors.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginDescription: The address of your Matomo, as https://host[:port] without a path. The tag fetches the experiment from it, so a change to the experiment needs no new version of the container.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginInvalid: The Matomo origin must look like https://host[:port], without a path.
RebelABTesting.InsertExperimentHelp: Add the tag "Rebel A/B Testing" to a container in Matomo Tag Manager, choose the experiment in it and publish the container.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameTooLong: The name of the experiment can be 255 characters at most.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameComma: The name of the experiment must not contain a comma.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameExists: The website already has an experiment with this name.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateFormat: The dates must be given as YYYY-MM-DD.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateOrder: The first day must not be after the last day.
RebelABTesting.ErrorOverlap: The website already has an experiment in this period. Only one experiment can run at a time.
RebelABTesting.ReportHelpText: Visits per experiment. Open an experiment to see its variants: 1 is the original and 2 the variant. A visit shows up once the reports are archived.
RebelABTesting.GoalsReportHelpText: Goal conversions by experiment, then variant, then goal. Open an experiment to see its variants, and a variant to see its goals.
RebelABTesting.ExperimentNotFound: This experiment could not be found. It may have been deleted.
RebelABTesting.FormNameHintNew: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Use a new name for every experiment.
RebelABTesting.FormHypothesisHint: What you expect and why, for example “A green button gets more clicks.”
RebelABTesting.FormVariantCodeHelp: Fill in CSS, JavaScript or both. Use CSS for how the page looks and JavaScript for what it does or says.
